V1.onde: Doc 2, App Store & Privacy, seção introdutória (parágrafo sobre melhoria da loja)
V1.verbatim: To find ways to improve the stores, we use information about your browsing, purchases, searches, and downloads.

To improve and optimize the experience in the App Store and other Apple apps, and services, we collect information about your usage of the App Store, including when you open or close the App Store, what content you search for, the content you view and download, and your interactions with App Store push notifications and badges, as well as messages from the App Store within apps.

We may also use your ratings and reviews of apps on the App Store and what you search for to improve models that power the App Store. For example, app reviews and aggregated search queries from you and other App Store users are used to provide review summaries and to fine-tune the App Store search model.

Choose your traffic proportion. Select the percentage of people who will be selected at random to be shown a treatment instead of your original App Store product page.
